title: A halo of pores around a hole enlarges the flaw
caption: A bare 20 Å hole (19.1 N/m), the same hole surrounded by two rings of pores (16.2 N/m) and by far-field pores (13.2 N/m): the rings and the pores turn the hole into a wider effective flaw bounded by thin ligaments; they do not shield it. Screened REBO2, athermal quasi-static uniaxial tension along x; colour: energy change per atom relative to the relaxed state (eV); red rings: atoms that have lost a bond; frames between stored quasi-static states are interpolated. All statements are model results.
slow_motion: 3x within ±0.0025 strain of first damage, peak load and major propagation
text_in_movie: chart axis labels and colour-bar numbers only
colour: energy change per atom relative to the relaxed state (eV), inferno colour map truncated at 0.9
chart: 2D stress (N/m) against engineering strain, one curve per panel in the panel's frame colour, moving marker at the current state
